full_text:
Poisonheat is a spell that produces a caustic green sludge from the casting Seeker's hands and directs at the target. This spell is similar to the acid that Kreutalk spits and to the Poisonfang spell.

== History ==
Dante Vale allowed himself to get hit by DeFoe's Poisonheat spell in order to rescue his team from the Organization's trap in the Prague Central Cemetery. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

== Gallery ==
